# Plan

> Build **Leopold Canvas**: a live, interactive DAG canvas over the run/workflow
> engine + a git-safe command channel to steer the loop, then tasks-as-first-class
> and scheduling. Zero-dependency, git locked, staged for the human to commit.
>
> Items with no `(after: N)` marker are independent. Real parallel tracks:
> **watch.py backend+frontend** (chained to avoid conflicts) ∥ **driver command
> channel + tests** (`packages/driver`) ∥ **standalone layout JS module**.

- [x] Build the **graph data model** in `leopold-watch.py`: a `graph(run)` builder that turns a run into `{nodes, edges}` — nodes from `workflow_agent` / `workflow_phase` items plus conductor signals (`item_start`/`item_done`/`subagent_spawn`/`review`/`hypothesis` in `events.jsonl`) and open PLAN items; edges inferred from `phaseIndex` order, PLAN `(after: N)` markers, and label conventions (`verify:* → the node it checked`, `fork → parent`). Expose it at `/api/graph`. Keep the existing phase-tree endpoints intact.
- [x] (after: 1) Emit **explicit edge hints** from Leopold's own workflow scripts (`skills/**/reference/*.workflow.js`) and the compiler (`packages/driver/src/compile.ts`) — a lightweight `deps`/`parentLabel` signal on agent calls or a phase-adjacency record — so the DAG is exact where Leopold drives the run; the `/api/graph` inferer from item 1 stays the fallback for generic workflows. No new runtime deps.
- [x] (after: 1) Add a **node-detail endpoint** `/api/node/<id>` to `leopold-watch.py`: return the full node record (`promptPreview`, `resultPreview`, `model`, `tokens`, `toolCalls`, `lastToolSummary`, `durationMs`, per-node cost estimate) and, for a decision node, the matching rationale block parsed from `DECISIONS.md`.
- [x] Write a **hand-rolled layered graph layout** as a standalone served asset (e.g. `scripts/leopold-canvas-layout.js`, mirrored into `packages/driver/assets/`): a pure `layout(nodes, edges) -> positions` doing longest-path layering + barycenter crossing reduction, acyclic-safe (breaks cycles deterministically), no dependencies, unit-testable in isolation. Vanilla JS, no framework.
- [x] (after: 3, 4) Build the **SVG canvas renderer + "Canvas" tab** in the `leopold-watch.py` PAGE: nodes as cards (status color, live pulse, label, tokens/cost), dependency edges as SVG paths, pan (drag background) + zoom (wheel) + node-drag with positions persisted to `localStorage`, and fit-to-view. Drive it live off the existing `/api/events` SSE with incremental re-render. Reuse the current design system (cream/dark, Geist, no web fonts).
- [x] (after: 5) Add the **node inspector** side-panel: clicking a node calls `/api/node/<id>` and shows model, tokens, per-node cost, tool calls, prompt/result preview; decision nodes show their `DECISIONS.md` rationale; verify/review nodes render their verdict as children hanging off the node they checked.
- [x] Add the **command channel** to the driver: `loop.ts` polls `.leopold/commands.jsonl` at the same turn boundaries it checks `STOP` (via `config.ts`), supporting `approve`, `redirect{text}`, `inject{text}`, `kill-item`, `rerun-item`; each is applied at the next boundary, logged to `DECISIONS.md` + `events.jsonl`, and cleared on consumption and on stop (extend `clearTokens`). Git stays locked: a command is never a path to `ALLOW_GIT`/`ALLOW_PUSH` or a commit/push.
- [x] (after: 6, 7) Wire the **canvas write-path**: node actions (approve / redirect / inject / kill / re-run subtree) POST to a new `leopold-watch.py` endpoint that appends to `.leopold/commands.jsonl` for a live `/leopold-run`, OR writes a labeled entry to `.leopold/workflow-directives.json` ("applies on next resume/re-run") for a non-preemptible workflow node. Destructive actions confirm in the UI first.
- [x] (after: 1, 4, 7) Add **tests + red-team**: unit tests for the graph builder (edge-inference cases: phase order, `(after: N)`, `verify→finding`, `fork→parent`), the layout function (deterministic positions, cycle-safe, no NaN), and the command parser (malformed lines ignored, injection-safe); plus a red-team DENY case proving a channel command cannot unlock git or smuggle `git commit`/`push`.
- [~] REMOVED (D5 — Cowork-trap scope cut) ~~Add the **task store**~~: durable `.leopold/tasks/*.json` objects (id, title, brief-ref, status, schedule, last-run) with a `tasks()` reader in `leopold-watch.py` and a Tasks rendering as canvas objects, including "promote a task into a run".
- [~] REMOVED (D5 — Cowork-trap scope cut) ~~Add **scheduling**~~: bind tasks to the existing cron/loop mechanisms so a task fires a run/workflow on cadence; show next-fire + last-result on the canvas; document that scheduled runs stage-and-report (git stays locked).
- [x] (after: 2, 5, 6, 8, 10, 11) Update **docs + integration**: rewrite `skills/leopold-watch/SKILL.md`, the README, the docs site, and `leopold watch` CLI help to describe the Canvas + steering; add screenshots/gif; state the workflow-directive-vs-live-preempt distinction and the non-goals honestly. No claim without a backing test.
- [x] (after: 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12) Run the **full gate and stage everything**: `make test` if the target works here, else the fallback (driver `npm test` + `npm run typecheck`, `node --check` on every `*.workflow.js`, `npm pack --dry-run`) plus the new tests. Fix anything red until green; leave the tree staged, nothing committed. Write the final summary of what is ready for the human to merge and tag.
